g.title: public.client_notes
g.text: Tiered notes: preference | internal | health. HEALTH notes are RLS-gated to clients.notes.health.view and must be read through the audited server route (reads cannot fire triggers, so auditing lives at the app layer). Append-only.

g.title: public.clients
g.text: Spa clients (no auth accounts). no_show_count is maintained by trigger from appointment status changes. flags is an extensible jsonb for operational booleans (requires_card_on_file).
Operational booleans, extendable without migrations. Known keys: requires_card_on_file
Stripe Customer id (cus_...). Created lazily by the setup-intent route on first card save. Single platform Stripe account; a future Connect retrofit would add an account dimension here.

HOW to reach the client: email | sms | both. text + check, not an enum type. SMS delivery is DEFERRED — every sender treats sms and both as email until the SMS phase lands (each delivery call carries a TODO) — but the preference is recorded from day one so no migration is needed then. Set by staff on the profile today; the public portal will read and write the same field.

Covers NON-TRANSACTIONAL communications only (birthday, post-visit follow-up). Transactional ones — confirmation, day-before reminder, cancellation notice, intake reminder — fire regardless of this flag; a client cannot opt out of being told about their own appointment. Default true; settable by staff and, later, by the client.

One lifetime waiver per client. Set on first forgiven late cancellation; never reset. See client-communications-design.md. It is a RECORD, not a setting: staff can read it on the profile but there is no UI to clear it, and the fee engine (phase 4) is its only writer. Not consumed when the fee could not be charged for lack of a card on file — the client did not receive the benefit.

g.title: public.client_notes:client_id->public.clients:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

g.title: public.staff
g.text: Employees. Linked 1:1 to auth.users via user_id. Deactivated (active=false), never deleted. Self-editable personal fields are guarded by trg_guard_staff_self_update.
Whether this person appears as a provider in scheduling (columns, qualification pickers, slot search).
